Class SpectatorServer

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.spectator.SpectatorServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SpectatorServer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The public spectator view: a web page that streams one court live and sells a clip of it.

It always listens on the loopback only; reaching it from outside takes a reverse proxy at a public HTTPS origin, or a temporary tunnel in demo mode. A sale is paid through a real Pix, a simulated one in demo mode, or not offered at all, and a clip is handed over only once its payment is confirmed.

  • Method Details

    • open

      public static SpectatorServer open(String address, String token, Path store) throws IOException
      Starts the server with real Pix sales when token is given, and no match yet.
      Parameters:
      address - the public HTTPS origin a reverse proxy serves this server at; blank or missing to serve only this machine
      token - the Mercado Pago access token that turns on real Pix sales; blank or missing to only watch
      store - the folder the clip orders are kept in
      Returns:
      the running server
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the address is not a bare HTTPS origin
      IOException - if the orders folder cannot be created or the port cannot be bound

    • open

      public static SpectatorServer open(String address, String token, Path store, boolean demo) throws IOException
      Starts the server, and no match yet. In demo mode every payment is simulated and the token is ignored.
      Parameters:
      address - the public HTTPS origin a reverse proxy serves this server at; blank or missing to serve only this machine
      token - the Mercado Pago access token that turns on real Pix sales; blank or missing to only watch
      store - the folder the clip orders are kept in
      demo - whether payments are simulated instead of charged
      Returns:
      the running server
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the address is not a bare HTTPS origin
      IOException - if the orders folder cannot be created or the port cannot be bound

    • shareDemo

      public String shareDemo() throws IOException
      Opens a temporary public address for a demo, through a Cloudflare quick tunnel that lives until the server closes. A server that already has a public origin keeps it.
      Returns:
      the address spectators open
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the server is not in demo mode
      IOException - if the tunnel cannot be started

    • broadcast

      public String broadcast(String source, int courtNumber, Path folder) throws IOException
      Starts the spectator broadcast of one court.
      Parameters:
      source - an address FFmpeg reads the live picture from — the recorder's relay, never the phone itself, which may serve a single client
      courtNumber - the court being streamed, which spectators buy clips of
      folder - the folder a fresh directory for this broadcast's live fragments is created in
      Returns:
      the address spectators open
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a match is already streaming
      IOException - if the broadcast encoder cannot be started
